hazards.name: Q Intervention
hazards.effect: Random: trial (pass a challenge for a buff), swap a fleet's location, remove a player's ships temporarily, fling a ship to Borg space.
hazards.counter: None. Q does what Q wants.

hazards.name: Mirror Universe Incursion
hazards.effect: Terran Empire duplicates of your own ships appear via a quantum rift.
hazards.counter: Seal the rift with a tachyon pulse, or fight your duplicates: they share your own ships' weaknesses.

choices.seal: Close the rift: incursion ends, no reward
choices.ally_rebels: Back the Terran rebels: a temporary rebel fleet, the Terran Empire turns hostile
choices.swap_captains: Trade a captain with their mirror double: steal one tech, risk a traitor in your fleet

hazards.name: Changeling Infiltration
hazards.effect: Hidden saboteur in a colony or fleet; random sabotage until found.
